resources.string: Repaint the words of the page with the colours of the well known Tajweed Quran. The legend is shown under the page. Madani pages only; the natural madd of two counts is not coloured.

Dark red: necessary madd (6 counts). Red: obligatory madd (4–5). Orange: permissible madd (2, 4 or 6). Green: ghunnah and its places (ikhfa, idgham with ghunnah, iqlab). Blue: qalqalah. Grey: letters that are not pronounced (hamzat al-wasl, lam shamsiyah, idgham without ghunnah).
